extDescription.message: Send browser downloads to the UIDM download manager.
extDescription.description: The extension's description in the browser's extension list and store. UIDM is the product name.

downloadWithUidm.description: Context menu item on a link, image, video or audio; also the button shown next to selected text that holds links.

downloadLaterWithUidm.description: Context menu item on a link, image, video or audio: adds it to UIDM's queue without starting it.

downloadAllLinksWithUidm.description: Context menu item on a page: lists the page's links in UIDM to pick from.

downloadSelectedLinksWithUidm.message: Download the selected links with UIDM
downloadSelectedLinksWithUidm.description: Context menu item on selected text: lists the links in the selection in UIDM to pick from.

uidmDisconnected.description: Why the extension is not connected, when the browser gives no reason. Shown as the REASON in statusNotConnectedReason.

captureDownloads.description: Popup checkbox: whether downloads the browser starts go to UIDM instead.

captureDownloadsTitle.message: Send downloads the browser starts to UIDM

statusConnected.message: Connected. Downloads you start in the browser go to UIDM.
statusConnected.description: Popup status line while connected to UIDM with capture on.

statusConnectedCaptureOff.message: Connected. Capture is off, so the browser keeps its own downloads.
statusConnectedCaptureOff.description: Popup status line while connected to UIDM with capture off.

statusNotConnected.message: Not connected to UIDM. Downloads stay in the browser.
statusNotConnected.description: Popup status line while UIDM cannot be reached and no reason is known.

statusNotConnectedReason.message: Not connected to UIDM: $REASON$. Downloads stay in the browser.
statusNotConnectedReason.description: Popup status line while UIDM cannot be reached. REASON is an error message, often from the browser or UIDM in English.

reason.example: Specified native messaging host not found

refreshWaiting.message: Your next download gives $NAME$ a new link.
refreshWaiting.description: Popup line while a download in UIDM waits for a new link: the next download the browser starts becomes that link.

stopWaiting.description: Popup button next to refreshWaiting: stop waiting for a new link.

skipNextDownload.description: Popup button: the next download the browser starts stays in the browser instead of going to UIDM.

skipNextDownloadTitle.message: Let the next download stay in the browser

dontSkip.description: The skipNextDownload button once pressed: undoes it.

skippingNextDownloadTitle.message: The next download stays in the browser

allLinks.description: Popup button: lists the current page's links in UIDM to pick from.

allLinksTitle.message: List this page's links in UIDM to pick the ones to download

videoButton.description: Popup checkbox: whether a download button shows over videos playing in web pages.

videoButtonTitle.message: A download button over videos playing in the browser

videoButtonOnSite.description: Popup checkbox next to videoButton: whether the video button shows on the current site.

urlPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the popup's address field.

download.description: Popup button that sends the pasted address to UIDM; also the video button's menu item for a whole video or audio file.

noDownloads.description: Popup download list when it is empty.

stateQueued.description: State of a download in the popup list: waiting in UIDM's queue.

stateDownloading.description: State of a download in the popup list.

stateDone.description: State of a download in the popup list: finished.

stateFailed.description: State of a download in the popup list.

stateCanceled.description: State of a download in the popup list.

stateInterrupted.description: State of a download in the popup list: stopped when UIDM closed; it can resume.

stateConfirming.description: State of a download in the popup list: UIDM's window asks the user something about it (the file name is taken).

stateWaiting.description: State of a download in the popup list: added to UIDM without starting it.

threatFound.description: Popup list: the virus scan found a threat in the downloaded file.

retry.description: Popup button on a failed, canceled or interrupted download.

remove.description: Popup button on a download: removes it from UIDM's list.

sizeProgress.description: Popup list: how much of a download has arrived, out of its whole size. Both are sizes such as sizeMB.

downloadVideo.description: The button the extension shows over a video playing in a web page; it opens a menu of what to download.

lookingForVideo.description: The video button's menu while it asks UIDM what the video offers.

videoProtected.message: This video is protected by DRM, so UIDM will not download it.
videoProtected.description: The video button's menu for a video with copy protection.

streamProtected.message: Protected by DRM; UIDM will not download it.
streamProtected.description: The video button's menu, under a stream with copy protection.

uidmNotConnected.message: UIDM is not running or not connected.
uidmNotConnected.description: The video button's menu when UIDM cannot be reached.

noVideoFound.message: No video found yet. Let it play for a moment, then try again.
noVideoFound.description: The video button's menu when the page has not loaded a video the extension recognizes.

sentToUidm.description: The video button's menu after a choice was sent to UIDM.

couldNotReachUidm.description: The video button's menu when sending a choice to UIDM failed.

hlsStream.description: The video button's menu: heading for a video streamed with HLS (a technical name).

dashStream.description: The video button's menu: heading for a video streamed with MPEG-DASH (a technical name).

mediaNoAnswer.description: The video button's menu, under a stream UIDM gave no details for.

soundOnly.description: The video button's menu item for a stream's sound without the picture. FORMAT is a file format.

videoFileType.description: The video button's menu: heading for a video file. TYPE is its file format.

audioFileType.description: The video button's menu: heading for an audio file. TYPE is its file format.

videoFile.description: The video button's menu: heading for a video file of unknown format.

audioFile.description: The video button's menu: heading for an audio file of unknown format.

takeoverFailed.message: UIDM could not take over the download
takeoverFailed.description: Title of the notice shown when UIDM could not take a download from the browser, which then downloads it itself.

takeoverNotConnected.message: UIDM is not running or not connected, so the browser downloads $FILE$.
takeoverNotConnected.description: Body of the notice when UIDM is not running or not connected. FILE is the download's file name or address.

takeoverError.message: UIDM could not start $FILE$ ($REASON$), so the browser downloads it.
takeoverError.description: Body of the notice when UIDM refused or could not start a download. FILE is the file name or address, REASON is UIDM's error message.

dontShowAgain.description: Button on the notice that UIDM could not take a download: stop showing such notices.

takeoverClickToStop.message: Click this notice to stop showing it.
takeoverClickToStop.description: Added to the notice in browsers whose notices have no buttons (Firefox): clicking the notice stops such notices.
